evidence_quotes.O: Out of curiosity I put the camcorder with the battery installed on the kitchen scale and it weighed in at under 14 oz.
evidence_quotes.C: After spending more time with the Monster phones I have decided to completely scrap my original review and focus just on the Monster and Bose comparison.
evidence_quotes.E: I spend a great deal of time in a computer lab where there is literally over 1,000 running systems.
evidence_quotes.A: So far, while I cannot say one is better than the other, they are both different in the features they provide and they both navigate well.
evidence_quotes.N: The M570 is marginally larger than my standard mouse which gave me pause right off the bat, but my concerns were unfounded.
